verdict.rationale: LM Studio's core purpose is downloading and running LLMs locally, via llama.cpp or Apple MLX. Its docs say document chat (RAG) works entirely offline and that voice data never leaves the device. The local server binds to localhost unless the user opens it to the network, and community users confirm it works as a local model runtime. Missing for 10: an explicit first-party privacy or telemetry statement that chat prompts and inference data never leave the device in general use, beyond the RAG and voice features.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can run inference entirely on my own machine so my data and prompts never leave my device

citations.quote: Download and run local LLMs like gpt-oss or Llama, Qwen
You can attach documents to your chat messages and interact with them entirely offline
Turning this on will open up the server to requests outside of 'localhost'.
Your voice and audio data is processed locally and never leaves your device.
